name: Legwork
description: Four players, four legs, one very large machine. Carry the cargo across clay, ice, lava and clockwork without going over.

controls.action: Aim the foot, push the body
Hold to lift, release to plant

help: Each player is one leg. A planted foot pushes where you aim; a lifted foot flies where you aim and lands when you let go. Keep the weight dot inside the polygon or the machine goes over. The gauge shows the stance from above: lift when your light is green. Step on the beat for the groove. Alone, the stick steers and bots step: hold Lift to take a foot.
